newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly firmer, expect gas oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly firmer, expect gas oil.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly stronger on Tuesday, except gas oil, traders said.
Gasoline rose $3.00 a tonne on strong trade demand for Eurograde barges and steeper backwardation.
Naphtha was steady, but a trader short for a prompt pipeline-spec cargo continued to bid the market up.
Heating oil premiums slumped by $5.00 per tonne as oversupply. partly from the U.S., fed through to cargo prices. IPE futures dipped by $3.25 per tonne.
Fuel oil was steady to firmer backed by rising crude.
